text:
Type: scented candle in a glass tumbler
Use: soft candlelight and fragrance on a table, shelf or sideboard; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: minimalist, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: clear glass container, colored scented wax, cotton wick
Colors: dark slate grey wax, clear glass
Shape: wide gently tapering tumbler filled with wax, single central wick, simple cylindrical outline, small and compact
Feel: cozy, calm, intimate, relaxing
Goes with: grey and white textiles, wood trays, ceramics, linen; minimalist, Scandinavian or contemporary rooms

product.name: SINNLIG
product.description: Creates atmosphere with a pleasant scent of calming spa and warm candlelight.
